real_defects.issue: PR #16504 tagged every parseCsv copy's rows with their file line but its guard only knew one loop shape (`for (let i ...) { line = i + 1`). 12 analyzers kept reporting the row index: `line: r + 1` inline (stripe-churn, stripe-failed-payment, airbnb, amazon-ppc, app-review-insights, google-ads, meta-ads, shopify-discount-leakage), `slice(1).forEach((r, n) => line = n + 2)` (oncall-load, pg-stat-statements, postgres-index-auditor) and `parseCsv(raw).forEach((row, i) => line: i + 1)` (restaurant-pos-menu-mix). One blank line before a bad row in a Stripe export reported line 3 for a row on line 5. Fixed in all 12; platform/ci/csv_line_numbers.mjs now walks every `line: v + 1|2` back to the loop that binds v (fails on main's 12 copies, passes after).
